_comment: Design done as 3 front-loaded workshops (in place of a /plan-1a dossier). Next: spec, informed by the workshops. No harness nodes (no governance doc). Phases revealed at /plan-3.

nodes.label: Design (3 workshops)
nodes.user_input: workshop the record type (load/use, core + extension) + retro + a sample type; then CLI shape; then what needs updating across our skills
nodes.note: Research/design done as three targeted workshops instead of a /plan-1a dossier; their decisions feed the spec.

nodes.label: Workshop 1 · record-type contract (load/use, core + extension)
nodes.user_input: workshop the record type and how they are loaded and used; core and extension; the retro record we have + a short sample of another type
nodes.note: 4-field contract {kind,type,description,template}; CLI is schema-agnostic (schema lives in template); core ∪ extension via the existing loader (kind discriminator); retro + dev-survey worked.

nodes.label: Workshop 2 · CLI shape
nodes.user_input: second workshop is cli shape please
nodes.note: harness record <type> (create) / --list (discover) / new <name> --record (author); reserved core name; envelope + E180/E181; placement .harness/records/<type>/<date>-<slug>.md + -NNN collision.

nodes.label: Workshop 3 · skills update inventory (flow adaptation)
nodes.user_input: third is what needs to be updated across our skills?
nodes.note: Write-site inventory W1–W7 (+ external X1–X2); headline decision RESOLVED: gitignored scratch buffer .harness/temp/<agent>/ (crash-resilient working memory) feeds a committed record materialized at drain via `harness record`; path migration docs/harness → .harness/records with back-compat harvest globs.

nodes.label: Spec
nodes.user_input: Round 1: Mode Simple (override Full); Testing Hybrid; Avoid mocks; Docs Hybrid
nodes.note: CS-3, Simple mode. Built from the 3 workshops; WS3 buffer/record split baked in. Agent-harness: N/A (this repo IS the harness). Workshop Opportunities all complete.

nodes.label: Plan · READY
nodes.note: Status READY; 7/7 gates PASS/N-A; 22 tasks, Simple single-phase. Validated (3 agents) — fixed 1 CRITICAL ordering bug (T006 merge before loader widened → split into T006 core-only + T009 merge).
